question_text: A woman complains that her husband has been controlling all the family finances, giving her only a small allowance, and preventing her from working. She also says he has destroyed her personal belongings. Under RA 9262, which of the following best describes the husband's actions?

options.text: The actions constitute economic abuse and psychological violence, which are forms of violence under RA 9262.
The actions are not covered by RA 9262 because there is no physical violence.
The actions are only considered economic abuse, which is not penalized under RA 9262.
The actions are only considered psychological violence, which requires a diagnosis of mental illness.
